name: Azure Firewall and NSG Policy Tampering
description: Azure Firewalls, network security groups, and application security groups decide which traffic is allowed in and out. Opening a rule to the internet, or deleting a deny rule, is how an attacker reaches a database or lets malware call home. This is the same idea as an AWS security group change, just in Azure networking. Wide-open source prefixes on management or data ports are the high-signal edits.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
